module: Post-processing fog. Creates the PostEffect "FogPostFx" (shader fog.cs.hlsl, priority 5, enabled, excluded from reflection passes) and the PostEffect "UnderwaterFogPostFx" (underwaterFog.cs.hlsl, priority 4, oneFrameOnly) with their shaders and state blocks. The underwater effect's callbacks enable/disable the caustics PostEffect.
notes: The callbacks are published on the global UnderwaterFogPostFxCallbacks (via rawset).

underwaterFogPostFxCallbacks.desc: Callbacks called by the engine for UnderwaterFogPostFx.

onEnabled.desc: Enables CausticsPFX if it exists and returns true.
